summary: Woodside Energy Group filed a Form 6-K with the SEC attaching an ASX announcement, dated September 14, 2026, disclosing the resignation of non-executive director Mark Cutifani CBE effective September 13, 2026, after joining the Board in March. Cutifani cited personal reasons and a reassessment of global professional commitments; he served on Audit Risk, Sustainability, and Nominations Governance Committees. Chair Richard Goyder acknowledged the departure. No successor, interim appointment, or timetable was disclosed. The resignation is abrupt and board-level, though framed as voluntary rather than a forced removal, so the event maps to a US-equivalent 8-K Item 5.02 director departure. Watch for follow-on 6-K filings naming a replacement, committee reassignments, or any strategic disagreement context, which would sharpen governance risk signals.
